extracted.name: One-pan cod & red shrimp
extracted.description: Stew chunks of cod with wild red shrimp to make a moreish, low-fat dinner. White fish is an important source of iodine, which is needed for a healthy metabolism
ingredient_lines: 1 large orange pepper deseeded and cut into chunks
200ml vegetable stock made with 1 tsp vegetable bouillon powder
280g pack cod loin cut into 6 large chunks
100g frozen wild red shrimp defrosted and peeled
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a wide non-stick pan over a medium heat and fry the potatoes, pepper and bay leaf for 5 mins until they start to colour. Add the leek and garlic, cook for a few minutes more, then stir in the passata and stock. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 25 mins until the potatoes are tender.

Add the parsley, cod, shrimp and green beans, then put the lid back on and cook for about 7 mins more, or until the fish flakes easily when pressed with a fork. Will keep chilled overnight, but best eaten fresh.
categories: BBC Good Food healthy diet plan
